source.label: IRS: Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract

method: Every 501(c)(3) organisation in the four regional files of the IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract (posted 10/13/2026) whose NTEE code begins G30 (cancer), G32 (breast cancer), H30 (cancer research) or H32 (breast cancer research), or whose registered or sort name contains a cancer word (cancer, leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma, oncology, tumor, sarcoma, melanoma and the like). Ronald McDonald House chapters are left out (Ronald McDonald House chapters house the families of any seriously ill child; the IRS codes several of them G30 but they are not cancer organisations). Ranked by the revenue on the organisation's latest filing as the IRS records it; the 300 largest are the list. Each EIN is a separate legal entity, so a centre with a hospital, a research institute and a foundation appears more than once. Detail links go to ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer, which presents the same IRS filings.
